card.name: End of 'probabilistic' and 'recurrent'
card.fires_on: The final piece of a split-up 'probabilistic' (often 'istic' after 'probabil') in technical text. It also fires on 'urrent' in 'Recurrent' and on the 'STM' ending of an abbreviation.

modes.label: probabilistic
modes.description: The ending 'istic' or 'ic' that completes 'probabilistic' in statistics or computing text.

modes.label: Recurrent
modes.description: The 'urrent' ending of 'Recurrent' at the start of a clinical phrase.

modes.label: Abbreviation end
modes.description: The 'STM' piece closing the abbreviation LSTM in a school name.

card.plain: It marks the last piece of a long word like 'probabilistic' that was split into parts.
